evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 13.5 ppm at start of growth, up from about 4-8 ppm during the ramp
O2 has risen with every reading to 54.5 ppm (about +8 ppm per 120 s) and is still climbing
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the rise is not from a change in purge flow
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C with stable heater power, so temperature control looks normal
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube pressure cannot be checked and the growth-stage atmosphere cannot be verified
